property_summary: For any caller and any guess hash, calling lockInGuess with exactly 1 ether always succeeds on the reference contract (it accepts msg.value == 1 ether) but the mutant that requires 2 ether will reject (revert) for calls sending 1 ether, so there exists inputs where the mutant fails while the reference succeeds.
change_summary: Change the requirement that msg.value == 1 ether to require msg.value == 2 ether, causing lockInGuess to accept only 2 ETH and thus alter stored guesses for callers sending 1 ETH.
